title: Very Small and Doesn't Cool Well at All
text:
Very Small and Doesn't Cool Well at All. I selected this mini fridge with one idea in mind - keeping a carton of creamer cold in the office, away from the kitchen so I can always be sure to have creamer for my coffee when I am in the office. I have been sorely disappointed in this unit.

It has two functions, heat and cool. I have little use for the heating function but I have tinkered with it, and it seems to work reasonably well. I have not measured the temperature, but it does keep an open cup of coffee warmer for a longer period of time and it does a reasonable job of working as a cup warmer which is a nice thing if you don't like pouring hot coffee or tea into a cold cup.

The first issue I have with it - and it's a major one - is that it just doesn't get all that cold. It does well enough to give a canned or bottled drink a slight chill but nowhere close to that of a typical refrigerator. This is all right if you don't like drinks that are really cold, but that somewhat defeats the purpose. In this case, a freezer pack in an insulated bag works better for me at cooling a bottled drink down. It is enough to raise some concern in my mind about food safety if leaving anything of consequence in this little fridge for more than a couple of hours. I certainly would not trust an open jar of mayo that was kept in this fridge overnight.

The second problem is that this fridge is too small to accommodate a quart-sized carton of cream, totally defeating the purpose for which I got it. It almost fits, but not quite. This is probably my fault for not measuring, but it's unfortunate nonetheless.

I have real difficulty recommending this little fridge. It's better than nothing I suppose, but there are better options if you're willing to spend a little more.
